state_policy: continuous portfolio and closed-shadow regime state across calendar boundaries
training_policy: no estimator fit, no calibration, no model/parameter selection in this rebuild
purge_embargo: not applicable to this no-fit chronological replay; any future fitting pipeline requires explicit label-horizon purge and embargo
contamination: historical 2021-2026 sample already used to select these alphas; chronological replay does not erase prior selection bias

prospective_holdout.start_rule: first UTC day after all technical gates pass and code/config/data-source manifests are committed
prospective_holdout.failure_to_meet_sample: INCONCLUSIVE; do not tune or retrospectively shorten the window
prospective_holdout.economic_gate: pre-register after TECHNICALLY_VALID, before first holdout observation; none inferred from retrospective performance
prospective_holdout.access_policy: no alpha or risk retuning using holdout; access and every attempted variant must be logged
